# Goody — account brief

## Who

Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Goody at ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `ongoody/goody-app` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- `package.json` pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 11 public repos and 64 followers ([source](https://github.com/ongoody))
- `ongoody/goody-app` last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app))
- The iOS app has 5,400 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157))
- 4 App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157))
- Goody links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://ongoody.com/careers))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 96 commits; profile lists company Goody, location Remote, website https://ongoody.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Goody. Maintains the Goody app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@ongoody-maintainer-2), 40 commits; profile lists company Goody, location New York, NY, website https://ongoody.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Goody mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Goody app." ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2))
- @ongoody-maintainer-3, 12 commits to `ongoody/goody-app`; the record lists no company, location, or bio ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-3))

## Why now

`ongoody/goody-app` last pushed 2026-07-29 and the App Store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)) ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). The repo is on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Goody app on Expo / React Native, and you are the top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 96 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). The repo has an `eas.json` and CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)) ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the App Store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). Across those four releases, what part of the path from a commit in `goody-app` to a build in review takes the most of your time?
